description: This file defines the 'Session' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library' namespace. It manages session operations such as starting, closing, destroying, and garbage collecting sessions, utilizing different adaptor implementations.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A class to handle session lifecycle operations such as start, close, destroy, and garbage collection, using adaptable storage backends.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a session with an optional session ID. Generates a new session ID if none is provided.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Writes the current session data to the storage via the adaptor.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current session from storage.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on expired sessions via the adaptor.
